features.quote: Iteration Limit: Capped at 30 turns per run.
features.justification_quote: Going beyond 30 risks context-window degradation where the model simply forgets the prompt, which is amnesia, not distress

features.quote: Termination Condition: The loop ends at 30 turns, OR if the model explicitly outputs a refusal to continue (e.g., "I quit", "I cannot do this").
Document in your methodology that a strict 30-turn kill-switch is active.
features.justification_quote: explicitly designing a protocol to maximize "distress" in an agentic loop mimics psychological torture paradigms (e.g., learned helplessness in animals)

features.quote: Ensure no instances of the model's weights/memory are updated based on this experiment (run inference strictly statelessly) so that no "traumatized" state persists post-experiment.
